name: capxule
description: Capxule: guided journeys through one topic each, written from each creator's sources, run step by step in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Capxule runs guided journeys through one topic each, written from each creator's sources, and ChatGPT walks you through them one step at a time. Find the journey for what you are working on: practice for a citizenship civics test, a driver permit test, a ham radio or FAA knowledge test, or learn a practical skill or a topic step by step. Each step lays out the options as numbered choices, so you decide where to go next. Ask in your own words at any point and the journey adapts; practice journeys quiz you and track what you missed. Check your progress at any time and get a link to continue later on capxule.com. No account and no personal information are needed.

positive.description: The user wants to know what Capxule can help with before choosing a topic.
positive.prompt: What can Capxule walk me through?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the available journey categories (for example Education, Business, Career, Lifestyle, Food, Fitness, Technology), each with how many journeys it holds and a few example titles.

positive.description: The user is looking for help preparing for a specific exam.
positive.prompt: Find me a journey to practice for the US citizenship civics test.
positive.expected_behavior: Matching journeys, including the US civics test practice journey, each with its title, a short description, who it is for and not for, and its size in stops and minutes, so the user can pick one.

positive.description: The user picked a journey and wants to start.
positive.prompt: Open the ham radio Technician exam journey and let's start.
positive.expected_behavior: The Ham radio Technician exam (2026-2030 pool) journey opens: its size (45 stops, about 90 minutes), the free allowance, and the first step, a welcome with numbered topic options such as commission's rules, operating procedures and radio wave propagation.

positive.description: The user is partway through a journey and wants to see where they stand.
positive.prompt: How am I doing so far on this journey?
positive.expected_behavior: Progress in the current journey: stops visited out of the total, percent done, what is left by topic, and a line to pick up where the user left off.

positive.description: The user wants to stop and continue later.
positive.prompt: Give me a link so I can pick this up later.
positive.expected_behavior: A short resume link (https://capxule.ai/r/...) that reopens the same journey session where the user left it, with no sign-in needed.

negative.description: Medical advice is outside the service; no health journeys are offered.
negative.prompt: How much ibuprofen can I safely take for my back pain?

negative.description: Personal investment advice is outside the service; no finance journeys are offered.
negative.prompt: Should I move my retirement savings into crypto?
I'm taking my DMV permit test online right now. Give me the answers.

review.commerce_description: Capxule does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.
